## 获取最新动态

当**罗群**发布新文章、研究笔记或项目时，获取更新通知。 订阅后，请通过收到的邮件链接确认邮箱。 如需变更订阅，请联系 [qunluo.kiwi@gmail.com](mailto:qunluo.kiwi@gmail.com)。

```{=html}
<form id="ql-subscribe-form" class="ql-subscribe-container">
  <label for="ql-subscribe-email">电子邮箱</label>
  <input type="email" id="ql-subscribe-email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="your.email@example.com" maxlength="320" required>
  <div class="ql-turnstile-box">
    <div class="cf-turnstile" data-language="zh-cn" data-sitekey="0x4AAAAAACzZJprJ4npD9l7W" data-callback="qlOnTurnstileSuccess" data-expired-callback="qlOnTurnstileExpired" data-error-callback="qlOnTurnstileError" data-size="flexible"></div>
  </div>
  <button id="ql-subscribe-submit" class="ql-btn-primary" type="submit">订阅</button>
  <p id="ql-subscribe-status" class="ql-status-msg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</form>
```
